title: fix(service-automation): http node failures name the target host and the underlying cause
body:
Part of #32161

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:流程里 http 节点连不上对方时,运行记录里的错误现在写明目标主机和真实原因(如域名解析失败、连接被拒、TLS 错误)。
- 为什么改:原先只写「fetch failed」,管理员无法判断是域名、对端、代理还是证书问题。
- 风险与回滚:只改失败时的一行文字;超时(timeout after Nms)和 HTTP 状态码文字不变;回滚即还原 http-nodes.ts 一个文件。
- 先看:packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/http-nodes.ts 的 describeFetchFailure(风险 hunk:对 url、查询串、用户名密码的脱敏)。
- 两分钟验证:pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/builtin/http-nodes.test.ts,预期 15 个全过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

A failed `http` node (inline arm) used to record `http: fetch failed`, dropping `err.cause` and the target. The error now reads `http: fetch failed — HOST: CODE cause message` (cause text capped at 200 characters), for example `http: fetch failed — no-such-host.invalid: ENOTFOUND getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND no-such-host.invalid`.

- Only the host is named, never the path, query or userinfo. Undici's credentials-in-URL TypeError quotes the whole URL (password included), so every occurrence of the url, its href, query, username and password is scrubbed to the host.
- Unchanged: `http: timeout after Nms` on abort, `HTTP STATUS` on a non-2xx, and the durable arm's enqueue error.
- The message is built in `builtin/http-nodes.ts`, as the premise reading said; no other site builds it.
- Changeset: `.changeset/32161-http-node-failure-cause.md` (patch).

This PR is `Part of #32161`: two items on the card stay open and are reported as questions, not implemented (the save waits for after-flows; execution vs wait time on resumed runs).

## Tests

- `http-nodes.test.ts`, new describe, real `fetch` against real failures: unknown host (ENOTFOUND, host named), refused port (ECONNREFUSED, host:port named), query secret, path secret and userinfo password absent from the message, timeout still `http: timeout after 50ms`, a cause-less error keeps its message plus host.
- 15/15 in the file; 127/127 across `src/builtin/http*`, `run-summary`, `connector-read-withheld-text`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck` exit 0.
- Ablation, once, after committing the fix: anchor `describeFetchFailure(err, url);` replaced by the old `e?.message ?? String(err);` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 hit, mutation landed on disk). Result: 4 red (unknown host, refused port, secret scrub, cause-less); the timeout test stayed green, as it should. Restored: `git diff HEAD` empty. Source-level import, no dist in the path.

## Acceptance notes

- NOT MEASURED locally: `pnpm check:query-options-erasure` (timed out at 300 s, exit 124, whole-repo lint-based gate; CI runs it).
- No out-of-scope findings filed.
